expected_marker_policy: All 65 R27 mandatory literals plus one R28 DP selection literal, LF+NUL in ELF. Compiled presence does not establish runtime reachability.
scope: Preserve all eight R27 after files byte-for-byte. In dp_display.c, guard two optional aux_switch_node name dereferences and log selected switch path once. Existing BYPASS branch continues all DP initialization; no DT, panel, core configuration or DP-disable change.
pointer_result_convention: rc=PTR_ERR for IS_ERR pointer; otherwise rc=0 and null explicitly identifies NULL; existing handling is unchanged
debug_policy: No drm.debug or core-config change in source. myron_r27_log_windows defaults false with permission 0444. Enable explicitly only in a subsequently reviewed runtime package.
original_failure_boundary: R27 live/pstore evidence shows all three DSI modes and DSI initialization completed, followed by DP connector post_init. Actual R27 ELF matches raw fault instruction f94002f8 at dp_display_post_init+0x248 to aux_switch_node->name. R26/R27 DP FDT node has empty qcom,dp-aux-switch property.

r27_observed_configuration_estimate.conditions: Successful path, one DSI, three CMD timing modes, no DFPS duplication, no callback recursion, modes populated once

r27_scope.owner: current task plus connector-init invocation token
r27_scope.unsafe_context: skip when in_atomic or irqs_disabled or in_interrupt; skip consumes a window
